title: The session relay logs every launch and drops unused hosts (S25)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S25 (Sector 6 — Harness and delivery (ADR 0022)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0022 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector. Counts toward the slop cut t-jgent6a.
Outcome: launches.jsonl records each successor launch; the hc host path is removed; cc-clearing-watch runs on a timer; handoff prose-shape checks become the inbox-to-task invariant
Files: see ADR 0022 Consequences.
Proof: `wc -l .krn/successors/launches.jsonl: grows by one per launch in the test`
Predicted: metric successor-launches-logged-share >= 0.9
